zoe_cs: Quick account pulse for NimbusEdge — weekly check. Error-rate jumped during their bulk syncs. Renewal touch in 2 days so flagging now.

High-level 7d vs prior 7d:
- overall error-rate: 3.0% -> 8.9%
- 5xx contribution: +4.5pp (now 6.2%)
- timeouts: ~x2.5 (notably on internal prefix lookups)
- 429s: 0.3% -> 1.6% (mostly on /v1/embeddings during bursts)

Top failing endpoints (last 24h):
1) POST /v1/sync/bulk    — 64% of 5xx, many 500/503s, p95 latency 1.8s
2) POST /v1/chat         — intermittent 502s during high memory pressure
3) POST /v1/embeddings   — 429s on short burst traffic, ~45% of errors are rate-limited
4) GET /internal/prefix-db — gateway timeouts while scanning large prefix sets

Context: NimbusEdge turned on a new parallel import pipeline yesterday; short high-rate bursts. They use dedicated pool ne-ded-9. Ops-alert: INCIDENT: nimbus-321 breach over 30m https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-2387654321

matt_eng: Looking into logs. Snippet 2026-03-22T04:12:03Z:
```
[2026-03-22T04:12:03Z] runtime: worker-04 allocation failed -> restart
[2026-03-22T04:12:03Z] proxy: upstream 502 from 10.55.9.4 for /v1/sync/bulk (req=nm123)
[2026-03-22T04:12:04Z] gateway: context deadline exceeded 14s for /internal/prefix-db (req=nm124)
[2026-03-22T04:12:05Z] quota: applied 429 -> /v1/embeddings (burst throttle)
```

matt_eng: Hypothesis: large memory footprint per bulk sync request -> OOM/worker restarts -> 502/timeouts. 429s come from client-side bursts hitting per-route QPS cap.

priya_infra: Quick mitigations I can apply immediately:
- fallback routing for /v1/sync/bulk -> nimbus-small-q4 for 2h to reduce memory
- bump ne-ded-9 max-instances +25% for 1h to absorb bursts
- throttle per-tenant embeddings bursts to 14 rps with Retry-After header
Commands I'll run:
```
rwctl routing set --customer nimbus-321 --route /v1/sync/bulk --fallback nimbus-small-q4 --duration 2h
rwctl pool update ne-ded-9 --max-instances +25% --duration 1h
rwctl quota set --customer nimbus-321 --route /v1/embeddings --burst-cap 14
```

matt_eng: Also rolling a canary runtime guard that returns 503 quickly on low-memory conditions to prevent retries cascading. Canary to 1 node now, ETA 20m.

carl_success: I will notify NimbusEdge tech lead: ask them to pause parallel imports for 90m and add client-side backoff for embeddings. I will note "mitigated - monitoring" in the renewal tracker and prepare a short update for the renewal call.

ops-alert: NOTE: INC-2387654321 mitigations applied (routing fallback + pool bump + quota throttle). Monitoring for recurrences.

priya_infra: Applied routing fallback and pool bump. Initial signal: 5xx down from 6.2% -> 2.9% in 12m, 429s ~1.0%. Continuing to watch.

matt_eng: Canary stable at 10m. If no regressions, will roll guard to 25% of ne-ded-9 in 15m.

carl_success: Thanks — I'll hold renewal call as low-risk for now and follow up in tomorrow's checkin. Follow-ups: 1) post-incident notes with NimbusEdge on import patterns, 2) recommend client caching for prefix lookups, 3) consider long-term quota bump if burst pattern continues.
